title: Solar PV and battery-storage scale-up to grid-flexibility bottlenecks
sourceNativeSummary: PV and batteries experienced large cost declines and deployment growth; as variable generation and electrified loads scaled, the system bottleneck increasingly moved into flexibility, storage, transmission, interconnection and grid operation.
rivalOrBoundary: The trajectory is explicitly system-level: cheap modules/cells do not by themselves create a reliable low-carbon power system.
